# App API reference (SDK 2.0.0)

Every method below is callable from plugins as `this.app.<namespace>.<method>(params)` and,
where marked, by the in-app assistant as a tool named `<namespace>_<method>`.
All methods take one params object and return a promise.

- **Permission** — what a plugin must declare in `manifest.json` (`none` = always allowed).
- **Assistant modes** — Ask reads, Edit also changes content, Creator can change the whole app.
- **Asks first** — the user confirms before it runs.

## app

### `app.info`

Get the app version, SDK version, theme and the open workspace.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `AppInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

```ts
const info = await app.info();
console.log(info.appVersion, info.theme);
```

## editor

### `editor.getActive`

Get the page open in the focused pane, or null when Home or nothing is open.

**Permission:** `editor.read` · **Returns:** `ActivePage | null` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `editor.getMarkdown`

Read the open page (or some of its blocks) as Markdown.

Custom blocks such as embedded databases come out as a short placeholder.

**Permission:** `editor.read` · **Returns:** `string` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane. |
| `blockIds` | `string[]` |  | Block ids, from editor.getBlocks. |

```ts
const md = await app.editor.getMarkdown();
```

### `editor.getBlocks`

List the open page's blocks with ids, types, text and nested children.

Use the ids with editor.updateBlock, editor.replaceBlocks, editor.removeBlocks and editor.insertMarkdown.

**Permission:** `editor.read` · **Returns:** `BlockSummary[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane. |

### `editor.getSelection`

Get the selected text, the selected block ids and the block with the cursor.

**Permission:** `editor.read` · **Returns:** `EditorSelection` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane. |

### `editor.snapshot`

Get word count, block count, plain text and outline of the open page.

**Permission:** `editor.read` · **Returns:** `EditorSnapshot | null` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `editor.insertMarkdown`

Insert Markdown at the cursor, at the start or end, or before/after a block.

**Permission:** `editor.write` · **Returns:** `{ blockIds: string[] }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown` | `string` | yes | Markdown. Headings, lists, checklists (- [ ]), quotes, code fences, tables and images are supported. |
| `position` | `"cursor" \| "start" \| "end" \| "before" \| "after"` |  | Where to insert. 'before'/'after' need blockId. Default `"end"`. |
| `blockId` | `string` |  | Anchor block for 'before'/'after'. |
| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane. |

```ts
await app.editor.insertMarkdown({ markdown: "## Summary\n- one\n- two", position: "end" });
```

| `pageId` | `string` |  | Page id. Defaults to the page open in the focused pane. |

## pages

### `pages.list`

List pages, folders and databases in the open workspace.

Pass parentId "" for top-level items. Database rows are pages whose parent is the database.

**Permission:** `pages.read` · **Returns:** `PageInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `parentId` | `string` |  | Only children of this item. "" = top level. |
| `kind` | `"page" \| "folder" \| "database"` |  | Only this kind. |
| `query` | `string` |  | Only titles containing this text (case-insensitive). |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Maximum results. Default `500`. |
| `includeRows` | `boolean` |  | Include database rows. Default `false`. |

```ts
const pages = await app.pages.list({ parentId: "" });
```

### `pages.create`

**Permission:** `pages.write` · **Returns:** `PageInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |

| `title` | `string` |  | Title. |

## databases

### `databases.list`

List databases with their row counts.

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

No parameters.

### `databases.getSchema`

Get a database's properties (columns) and views.

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseSchemaInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |

### `databases.queryRows`

Read a database's rows with values keyed by property name.

Select/status values come back as option names. `where` matches exact values (case-insensitive for text).

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseRowInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `where` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Property name → value that must match. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Maximum rows. Default `200`. |

```ts
const rows = await app.databases.queryRows({ databaseId, where: { Status: "Done" } });
```

### `databases.create`

Create a database with properties.

Property types: text, number, select, multiSelect, status, date, checkbox, url, email, phone, createdTime, lastEdited.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `{ databaseId: string }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Database title. |
| `parentId` | `string` |  | Parent page/folder id. |
| `properties` | `{ /** Property name. */ name: string; /** Property type. */ type: "text" \| "number" \| "select" \| "multiSelect" \| "status" \| "date" \| "checkbox" \| "url" \| "email" \| "phone" \| "createdTime" \| "lastEdited"; /** Options for select / multiSelect / status. */ options?: string[]; }[]` |  | Columns besides the title. |
| `view` | `"table" \| "board" \| "gallery" \| "list" \| "calendar"` |  | First view type. Default `"table"`. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Open it in a tab. Default `true`. |

### `databases.addProperty`

Add a property (column) to a database.

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |

| `type` | `"text" \| "number" \| "select" \| "multiSelect" \| "status" \| "date" \| "checkbox" \| "url" \| "email" \| "phone" \| "createdTime" \| "lastEdited"` | yes | Property type. |
| `options` | `string[]` |  | Options for select / multiSelect / status. |

Add a row; values are keyed by property name.

Dates: ISO "2026-03-01". Selects: option name (created if missing). Multi-select: array of names. Checkbox: boolean.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `{ rowId: string }` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `title` | `string` |  | Row title. |
| `values` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Property name → value. |

Change a row's title and/or values (keyed by property name).

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rowId` | `string` | yes | Row (page) id. |
| `title` | `string` |  | New title. |
| `values` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Property name → value. null clears. |

### `databases.getView`

Get one view with its filters, sorts, grouping, visible properties and calculations.

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `viewId` | `string` |  | View id (defaults to the first view). |

### `databases.queryView`

Read rows the way a view shows them (its filters and sorts applied), optionally with a search.

**Permission:** `databases.read` · **Returns:** `DatabaseRowInfo[]` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `viewId` | `string` |  | View id (defaults to the first view). |
| `search` | `string` |  | Text search across all properties. |
| `filters` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Operator. */ op: "contains" \| "notContains" \| "is" \| "isNot" \| "startsWith" \| "endsWith" \| "isEmpty" \| "isNotEmpty" \| "eq" \| "neq" \| "gt" \| "lt" \| "gte" \| "lte" \| "before" \| "after" \| "onOrBefore" \| "onOrAfter"; /** Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty). */ value?: unknown; }[]` |  | Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO. |
| `filterMode` | `"and" \| "or"` |  | and \| or for `filters`. |
| `sorts` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Direction. */ direction?: "asc" \| "desc"; }[]` |  | Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts). |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Maximum rows. Default `200`. |

```ts
const late = await app.databases.queryView({ databaseId, filters: [{ property: "Due", op: "before", value: "2026-01-01" }], sorts: [{ property: "Due" }] });
```

### `databases.addView`

Add a view (table, board, gallery, list or calendar) with optional filters, sorts and grouping.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `DatabaseViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `databaseId` | `string` | yes | Database id. |
| `name` | `string` |  | View name. |
| `type` | `"table" \| "board" \| "gallery" \| "list" \| "calendar"` |  | Layout. Default `"table"`. |
| `filters` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Operator. */ op: "contains" \| "notContains" \| "is" \| "isNot" \| "startsWith" \| "endsWith" \| "isEmpty" \| "isNotEmpty" \| "eq" \| "neq" \| "gt" \| "lt" \| "gte" \| "lte" \| "before" \| "after" \| "onOrBefore" \| "onOrAfter"; /** Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty). */ value?: unknown; }[]` |  | Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO. |
| `filterMode` | `"and" \| "or"` |  | Match all rules (and) or any (or). |
| `sorts` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Direction. */ direction?: "asc" \| "desc"; }[]` |  | Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts). |
| `groupBy` | `string` |  | Board/table grouping property (select, multi-select, status, checkbox). "" removes grouping. |
| `hiddenGroups` | `string[]` |  | Group values (option names) to hide on a board. |
| `show` | `string[]` |  | Properties to show, in order (others are hidden). |
| `hide` | `string[]` |  | Properties to hide. |
| `order` | `string[]` |  | Property order (names or ids). |
| `widths` | `Record<string, number>` |  | Property → column width in px (table). |
| `calcs` | `Record<string, "none" \| "countAll" \| "countValues" \| "countUnique" \| "countEmpty" \| "countNotEmpty" \| "percentEmpty" \| "percentNotEmpty" \| "checked" \| "unchecked" \| "percentChecked" \| "sum" \| "average" \| "median" \| "min" \| "max" \| "range" \| "earliest" \| "latest">` |  | Property → footer calculation (table). |
| `dateProperty` | `string` |  | Date property for calendar views. |
| `cardPreview` | `"cover" \| "none"` |  | Card preview for board/gallery. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` |  | Wrap long cell text. |

```ts
await app.databases.addView({ databaseId, type: "board", name: "By status", groupBy: "Status", filters: [{ property: "Done", op: "is", value: false }] });
```

### `databases.updateView`

Change a view: name, layout, filters, sorts, grouping, visible properties, order, widths, calculations.

Only the fields you pass change. `filters` and `sorts` replace the existing lists; pass [] to clear.

**Permission:** `databases.write` · **Returns:** `DatabaseViewInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Edit, Creator

| `viewId` | `string` | yes | View id. |
| `name` | `string` |  | View name. |
| `type` | `"table" \| "board" \| "gallery" \| "list" \| "calendar"` |  | Layout. |
| `filters` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Operator. */ op: "contains" \| "notContains" \| "is" \| "isNot" \| "startsWith" \| "endsWith" \| "isEmpty" \| "isNotEmpty" \| "eq" \| "neq" \| "gt" \| "lt" \| "gte" \| "lte" \| "before" \| "after" \| "onOrBefore" \| "onOrAfter"; /** Value to compare with (omit for isEmpty / isNotEmpty). */ value?: unknown; }[]` |  | Filter rules (replaces the view's filters). Select/status/multi-select values are option names; dates are ISO. |
| `filterMode` | `"and" \| "or"` |  | Match all rules (and) or any (or). |
| `sorts` | `{ /** Property name or id ("title" or the title column's name for the title). */ property: string; /** Direction. */ direction?: "asc" \| "desc"; }[]` |  | Sort rules, first wins (replaces the view's sorts). |
| `groupBy` | `string` |  | Board/table grouping property (select, multi-select, status, checkbox). "" removes grouping. |
| `hiddenGroups` | `string[]` |  | Group values (option names) to hide on a board. |
| `show` | `string[]` |  | Properties to show, in order (others are hidden). |
| `hide` | `string[]` |  | Properties to hide. |
| `order` | `string[]` |  | Property order (names or ids). |
| `widths` | `Record<string, number>` |  | Property → column width in px (table). |
| `calcs` | `Record<string, "none" \| "countAll" \| "countValues" \| "countUnique" \| "countEmpty" \| "countNotEmpty" \| "percentEmpty" \| "percentNotEmpty" \| "checked" \| "unchecked" \| "percentChecked" \| "sum" \| "average" \| "median" \| "min" \| "max" \| "range" \| "earliest" \| "latest">` |  | Property → footer calculation (table). |
| `dateProperty` | `string` |  | Date property for calendar views. |
| `cardPreview` | `"cover" \| "none"` |  | Card preview for board/gallery. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` |  | Wrap long cell text. |

### `appearance.setTokens`

Override design tokens (colors, fonts, radii, sizes) for light and/or dark.

Keys are token names without the leading dashes, e.g. { accent: "#2f6fdf", "radius-md": "12px" }. A null value removes an override.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `light` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Token → CSS value for the light theme. |
| `dark` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Token → CSS value for the dark theme. |
| `both` | `Record<string, unknown>` |  | Token → CSS value for both themes. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

```ts
await app.appearance.setTokens({ both: { accent: "#2f6fdf" }, dark: { bg: "#111418" } });
```

### `appearance.styleComponent`

Style or hide an app component (see appearance.listComponents).

`css` is a list of declarations applied to the component's root, e.g. "border-radius: 16px; background: var(--bg-sunken)". Use `rules` for nested selectors.

**Permission:** `appearance` · **Returns:** `Customizations` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | `string` | yes | Component id. |
| `css` | `string` |  | CSS declarations for the component root. "" clears. |
| `rules` | `string` |  | Extra CSS rules; `&` is replaced by the component selector. |
| `hidden` | `boolean` |  | Hide the component. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

| `css` | `string` | yes | CSS. |
| `label` | `string` |  | Human label. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` |  | Enabled. Default `true`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

| `id` | `string` | yes | Tab id, unique for this plugin or layer (letters, digits, dots, dashes). |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Tab title. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line". |
| `markdown` | `string` |  | Markdown content. |
| `actions` | `{ /** Action id. */ id: string; /** Label. */ label: string; /** Primary style. */ primary?: boolean; }[]` |  | Buttons under Markdown content; pressing one raises panel:action (plugins). |
| `html` | `string` |  | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `open` | `boolean` |  | Show the sidebar and activate the tab. Default `false`. |
| `split` | `boolean` |  | Open in a new group below the others. Default `false`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

```ts
await app.sidebar.setTab({ id: "tasks", title: "Tasks", icon: "list-checks", html: "<ul id=list class=n-list></ul><script>noteral.app.databases.queryRows({databaseId:'…'}).then(r=>list.innerHTML=r.map(x=>'<li>'+x.title).join(''))</script>", open: true });
```

## blocks

### `blocks.registerType`

Register a custom editor block type rendered by an HTML view; it appears in the slash menu.

Each block stores JSON data in the page. In the view, read it from `noteral.props.data` and save changes with `noteral.setData(next)`; `noteral.props.editable` says whether the page can be edited. Keep `type` stable: documents reference it.

**Permission:** `blocks` · **Returns:** `BlockTypeInfo` · **Callers:** plugins, assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `string` | yes | Type id, e.g. "kanban-mini" (lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes). |
| `title` | `string` | yes | Name in the slash menu. |
| `description` | `string` |  | Slash menu hint. |
| `icon` | `string` |  | Icon: an emoji or a Lucide icon name such as "chart-line". |
| `keywords` | `string[]` |  | Extra search words. |
| `html` | `string` | yes | HTML for a sandboxed view (a fragment or a full document; inline <style> and <script> are fine, no remote scripts). The script gets a global `noteral` (props, setData, call, on, open, notify — see the View API guide). Theme tokens are available as CSS variables, and the kit classes n-btn, n-input, n-card, n-row, n-col, n-grid, n-chip, n-list, n-muted are predefined. |
| `defaultData` | `unknown` |  | Data for new blocks. |
| `height` | `number` |  | Initial height in px (the view auto-resizes). Default `120`. |
| `layer` | `string` |  | Customization layer to write to. Assistant: defaults to this chat's layer (so the user can switch it off). Plugins: defaults to the plugin's own layer. "base" writes the base look. |

```ts
await app.blocks.registerType({ type: "counter", title: "Counter", icon: "plus", defaultData: { n: 0 }, html: "<button class=n-btn id=b></button><script>const r=()=>b.textContent='Clicked '+noteral.props.data.n;r();noteral.onProps(r);b.onclick=()=>noteral.setData({n:noteral.props.data.n+1})</script>" });
```

### `plugins.create`

Install (or update) a plugin written by the assistant. The user reviews the code and permissions first.

code is plain JavaScript run in a sandbox. It must call Noteral.register(class extends Noteral.Plugin { async onload() {…} onunload() {…} }). Use this.app.<namespace>.<method>(params) for every App API method (e.g. this.app.sidebar.setTab, this.app.statusBar.setWidget, this.app.blocks.registerType, this.app.nodes.registerType, this.app.home.addWidget), this.addCommand({ id, title, run }), this.setStatus(itemId, text), this.setPanel(panelId, { title, markdown, actions }), this.onPanelAction(panelId, fn), this.onViewMessage(fn), this.registerEvent(eventName, fn), this.addStyles(css), this.loadData() / this.saveData(patch). The plugin is test-run first (see plugins.test) and, after installing, its start-up is checked: the result's `health` reports errors so you can fix and reinstall.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginInstallResult` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `{ /** Reverse-DNS id, e.g. com.assistant.word-goal. */ id: string; /** Name. */ name: string; /** Semver, e.g. 1.0.0. */ version: string; /** What it does. */ description: string; /** Permissions the code needs. */ permissions?: string[]; /** Commands it adds. */ commands?: { /** Command id (lowercase, dashes). */ id: string; /** Title. */ title: string; }[]; /** Status bar items. */ statusItems?: { /** Item id. */ id: string; /** Label. */ label: string; }[]; /** Sidebar panels. */ panels?: { /** Panel id. */ id: string; /** Title. */ title: string; }[]; }` | yes |  |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Plugin JavaScript. |
| `styles` | `string` |  | Optional CSS (needs ui.styles). |
| `skipTest` | `boolean` |  | Install even if the test run reports errors. Default `false`. |

### `plugins.test`

Run plugin code in a throw-away sandbox without installing it, and report errors, logs, commands and UI it registered.

Write calls (except UI registration) are skipped during the test. Always test before plugins.create and fix every reported error.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `PluginTestResult` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `{ /** Plugin id. */ id: string; /** Name. */ name: string; /** Version. */ version?: string; /** Permissions. */ permissions?: string[]; }` | yes |  |
| `code` | `string` | yes | Plugin JavaScript. |
| `styles` | `string` |  | CSS. |
| `waitMs` | `number` |  | How long to watch it (ms). Default `1500`. |

### `plugins.logs`

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `LogEntryInfo[]` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Ask, Edit, Creator

| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `limit` | `number` |  | Entries. Default `50`. |

### `plugins.uninstall`

Uninstall a plugin.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator · **Asks first**

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |

### `plugins.setEnabled`

Enable or disable an installed plugin.

**Permission:** none · **Returns:** `void` · **Callers:** assistant · **Assistant modes:** Creator

| Param | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes | Plugin id. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | yes | Enabled. |

## Events

Subscribe with `this.registerEvent(name, handler)`. Events are only computed while someone listens.

| Event | Payload | Permission | When |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `document:changed` | `EditorSnapshot` | `editor.read` | The open page changed (debounced). Payload is the editor snapshot. |
| `page:opened` | `ActivePage \| null` | none | A different page (or Home) became active. |
| `theme:changed` | `{ theme: "light" \| "dark" }` | none | Light/dark theme changed. |
| `workspace:opened` | `WorkspaceInfo` | none | A workspace was opened. |
| `pages:changed` | `{ count: number }` | `pages.read` | Pages were created, renamed, moved or trashed. |
| `panel:action` | `{ panelId: string; actionId: string }` | `ui.panel` | A button in one of the plugin's panels or Markdown tabs was pressed. |
| `view:message` | `{ view: string; name: string; payload: unknown }` | none | One of the plugin's HTML views called noteral.post(name, payload). |

## Permissions

| Permission | Risk | Grants |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `editor.read` | low | **Read the open page.** Read the text, blocks and selection of the page you are editing. |
| `editor.write` | medium | **Edit the open page.** Insert, change and remove blocks in the page you are editing. |
| `pages.read` | medium | **Read pages.** List pages and read the content of any page in the workspace. |
| `pages.write` | high | **Change pages.** Create, rename, move, rewrite and trash pages. |
| `databases.read` | medium | **Read databases.** Read database schemas and rows. |
| `databases.write` | high | **Change databases.** Create databases, add properties and add or edit rows. |
| `navigation` | low | **Navigate.** Open pages, go back and forward, open Home. |
| `search.read` | medium | **Search.** Run full-text searches across the workspace. |
| `ui.status` | low | **Status bar.** Show text and widgets in the status bar. |
| `ui.notify` | low | **Notifications.** Show toast notifications. |
| `ui.panel` | low | **Sidebar tabs.** Add tabs to the right sidebar. |
| `ui.modal` | low | **Dialogs.** Ask you to confirm, type an answer or pick from a list. |
| `ui.styles` | medium | **Plugin styles.** Add CSS to the app (for the plugin's own look). |
| `settings.read` | low | **Read its settings.** Read the plugin's own saved settings. |
| `settings.write` | low | **Save its settings.** Save the plugin's own settings. |
| `assets.read` | low | **Read files.** Read images and files attached to pages. |
| `assets.write` | low | **Import files.** Ask you to pick an image or file and import it. |
| `workspaces.read` | low | **See workspaces.** List workspaces and see which one is open. |
| `workspaces.write` | high | **Manage workspaces.** Create, rename and switch workspaces. |
| `layout` | low | **Layout.** Split panes, arrange sidebar tab groups, show or hide sidebars and resize panels. |
| `appearance` | medium | **Appearance.** Change colors, fonts and component styles across the app. |
| `preferences` | medium | **Preferences.** Read and change app preferences such as theme and font size. |
| `commands.execute` | high | **Run commands.** Run any command from the command palette. |
| `clipboard` | medium | **Clipboard.** Read and write the clipboard. |
| `network` | high | **Internet access.** Make web requests, search the web and fetch pages. |
| `blocks` | low | **Custom blocks.** Add new kinds of blocks to the editor (rendered in a sandbox). |
| `nodes` | low | **Custom page types.** Add new kinds of items to the page tree (rendered in a sandbox). |
| `home` | medium | **Home.** Create, change and remove Home views and widgets. |

## Types

Return types, as shipped in `@noteral/sdk` (`sdk/src/types.ts`).

```ts
export interface AppInfo {
  appName: string;
  appVersion: string;
  sdkVersion: string;
  platform: string;
  theme: "light" | "dark";
  workspaceId: string | null;
}

export interface ActivePage {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  paneId: string;
  /** True when the page is open in a live editor (editor.* methods work on it). */
  editable: boolean;
}

export interface BlockSummary {
  id: string;
  type: string;
  text: string;
  props?: Record<string, unknown>;
  children?: BlockSummary[];
}

export interface EditorSelection {
  text: string;

  cursorBlockId: string;
}

  id: string;
  text: string;
  level: number;
}

export interface EditorSnapshot {
  pageId: string;
  title: string;
  wordCount: number;
  blockCount: number;
  text: string;
  outline: OutlineItem[];
}

export interface PageInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: string;
  cover: string;
  kind: "page" | "folder" | "database" | "row" | "custom";
  /** Custom node type id, for kind "custom" (see nodes.listTypes). */
  nodeType?: string;
  parentId: string;
  /** For rows: the database they belong to. */
  databaseId?: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  deleted?: boolean;
}

export interface PageContent {
  page: PageInfo;
  format: "markdown" | "text";
  content: string;
  /** Child pages (and database rows) directly under this page. */
  children: PageInfo[];
}

export interface DatabaseInfo {
  id: string;
  title: string;

  rowCount: number;
  properties: string[];
}

}

  title: string;
  titleName: string;
  properties: DatabasePropertyInfo[];
  views: { id: string; name: string; type: string }[];
}

export interface DatabaseViewInfo {
  databaseId: string;

  hiddenGroups?: string[];

  cardPreview?: "cover" | "none";
  wrap?: boolean;

  calcs?: Record<string, string>;
}

  id: string;

  /** Values keyed by property name; select options are returned by name. */

export interface PluginManifest {
  /** Reverse-domain id, e.g. "com.example.word-goal". Never changes between versions. */
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Semver, e.g. "1.2.0". Must match the GitHub release tag (with or without "v"). */

  contributes?: {
    commands?: Array<{ id: string; title: string; description?: string; keywords?: string }>;
```
